messages:
Ravi (Finance): Marta forwarded a BizLytics dispute: Feb invoice shows $1,203.60 for tokens but their internal logs only show ~3.2M tokens. Our billable says 6.0M. Can billing + SRE check why we're ~2.8M higher?
Marta (Support): customer ticket #TKT-9981 attached their app logs and request IDs. They claim many requests were rate-limited and retried client-side; they expect only successful completions to be billable.
Lena (Billing): important: our pricing docs say billable = accepted request tokens. But we also have a rate-cap policy that returns 429 before accepting. Are we billing 429s?
Tom (SRE): quick check: metering code increments counter on request.accept path, post-auth; but there's a race where a retry with same id sometimes gets ingested as separate accept before de-dupe. Looking at logs for bizlytics: search query below.
Lena (Billing): paste the query you ran please.
Tom (SRE): ```sql
-- tokens_billed by metering table
SELECT event_type, sum(tokens) as tokens_total
FROM metering_events
WHERE customer_id='bizlytics' AND event_month='2026-02'
GROUP BY 1;
-- result: accept: 6_000_123; 429: 1_120_004; retry_insert: 0
```
Tom (SRE): We also looked at request_stream for client-side logs: many requests had identical client_request_id but different server_request_id. Dedup currently keys on client_request_id for responses but metering accepted created before client_request_id dedupe landed. There was a deployment on 2026-03-02 that added stronger dedupe. commit: git/commit/faceb00c
metering-bot: alert: dedupe-migration ran 2026-03-02T01:05Z. affected_customers=["bizlytics","acme","delta-hr"] rows_examined=4,120,334 duplicates_fixed=1,210,011 job=dedupe-20260302-1
Ravi (Finance): so the 1.2M duplicates match roughly the delta. Can we compute exact overlap vs customer-provided logs?
Tom (SRE): ran matching on client_request_id vs invoice ids. Found 1,198,745 billed tokens that have matching client_request_id duplicates. That aligns with ~2.8M token difference when multiplied by avg token per request.
Lena (Billing): what's the dollar impact? Pricing tier for BizLytics: $0.00045 per token. delta_tokens ~2,800,000 => delta_amount = $1,260.00 (rough). Confirm?
Ravi (Finance): Marta, tell BizLytics we acknowledge and will issue credit if their claim holds after vetting. Need Finance Manager sign-off to create credit memo. Please include exact evidence.
Isha (Finance Manager): approve provisional credit up to $1,300 pending final reconciliation. Use GL code BILL-ADJ-2026-Q1.
Lena (Billing): created credit memo CM-8021 provisional $1,300 applied to INV-BIZ-202602-01 (status: pending). Added note: "provisional credit for duplicate meter ingestion; final amount pending SRE reconciliation".
Marta (Support): replied to customer pointing to provisional credit and asking for any additional request_ids they want us to match. :thumbsup:
Tom (SRE): action items: 1) run cross-customer dedupe scan (scheduled job id dedupe-scan-20260302-2) 2) export matched request ids to share with BizLytics (sensitive, will redacted) 3) add metric to billing dashboard for 'accepted tokens deduped' to catch regressions.
Ravi (Finance): please add final reconciliation to next week's billing ops review. Also small ask: can Product docs clarify that retried-but-accepted requests are billable and we are fixing duplicate ingestion edgecases?
Isha (Finance Manager): noted. Close out when SRE posts reconciliation results and billing posts final memo amount.
Lena (Billing): marking thread resolved for now; will update CM once Tom posts final numbers.
